questions.text: The classroom floor has no rubbish. How is the classroom?
questions.discussion: Tidak ada sampah menjadi bukti bahwa kelas bersih.

questions.text: There is mud and rubbish on the schoolyard. How is it?
questions.discussion: Lumpur dan sampah menunjukkan keadaan kotor.

questions.text: The library has space for many tables and shelves. How is the library?
questions.discussion: Ruang yang mampu memuat banyak meja dan rak dapat digambarkan **big**.

questions.text: The canteen has only two small tables. How is the canteen?
questions.discussion: Petunjuk dua meja kecil mendukung deskripsi **small**.

questions.text: The prayer room can hold many people. Which word describes its size?
questions.discussion: **Large** berarti besar atau luas.

questions.text: Only one person can walk through the restroom entrance at a time. How is the entrance?
questions.discussion: Jalan masuk yang lebarnya terbatas disebut **narrow**.

questions.text: The schoolyard has plenty of space from left to right. Which word fits?
questions.discussion: **Wide** berarti lebar.

questions.text: What is the opposite of **clean**?
questions.discussion: Lawan kata **clean** adalah **dirty**.

questions.text: What is the opposite of **big**?
questions.discussion: Lawan kata **big** adalah **small**.

questions.text: What is the opposite of **narrow**?
questions.discussion: Lawan kata **narrow** adalah **wide**.

questions.text: Which word has a similar meaning to **big**?
questions.discussion: Dalam deskripsi ukuran ruangan, **large** juga berarti besar.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.discussion: Subjek tunggal **the classroom** memakai **is** sebelum kata sifat.

questions.text: Which question asks about the condition of the canteen?
questions.discussion: Pola sasaran Unit 9 adalah **How is the ...?**.

questions.text: A: How is the canteen? B: ___.
questions.discussion: Jawaban menyebutkan kondisi atau ukuran tempat.

questions.text: Complete: The office is small ___ clean.
questions.discussion: Kata **and** menggabungkan dua kondisi tempat.

questions.text: The library is big and clean. Which two words describe it?
questions.discussion: Dua kata sifat pada kalimat adalah **big** dan **clean**.

questions.text: The restroom is narrow. What does **narrow** describe?
questions.discussion: **Narrow** menjelaskan lebar yang terbatas.

questions.text: The schoolyard is large. Which statement matches?
options: It has a lot of space.
It can hold only one chair.
questions.answer: It has a lot of space.
questions.discussion: **Large** menunjukkan ukuran atau ruang yang besar.

questions.text: Read: “The office is small and clean.” Is the office dirty?
questions.discussion: Kalimat menyebutkan kantor bersih.

questions.text: Read: “The classroom is big but the door is narrow.” What is narrow?
questions.discussion: Kata **narrow** menerangkan pintu.

questions.text: Classroom A is clean. Classroom B is dirty. Which room needs cleaning?
questions.discussion: Ruang B secara jelas disebut kotor.

questions.text: The canteen is small, but the schoolyard is large. Which place is larger?
questions.discussion: Sekolah lapang disebut **large**, sedangkan kantin **small**.

questions.text: The library is large and clean. Which statement is supported?
questions.discussion: Jawaban mengulang dua kondisi yang dinyatakan.

questions.text: A room is clean. Can we conclude that it is large?
options: No, cleanliness does not tell its size.
Yes, all clean rooms are big.
questions.answer: No, cleanliness does not tell its size.
questions.discussion: Kebersihan dan ukuran adalah ciri yang berbeda.

questions.text: A room is narrow. Can we conclude that it is dirty?
options: No, width does not tell its cleanliness.
Yes, narrow rooms are always dirty.
questions.answer: No, width does not tell its cleanliness.
questions.discussion: Lebar ruangan tidak menentukan kebersihannya.

questions.text: Arrange the words: **library – The – large – is**.
questions.discussion: Urutan yang benar adalah subjek + **is** + kata sifat.

questions.text: Which report uses two correct describing words?
options: The classroom is big and clean.
The classroom are big and clean.
questions.answer: The classroom is big and clean.
questions.discussion: Kalimat lengkap memakai **is** dan dua kata sifat.

questions.text: Rina asks five friends about the library. Three say “large” and two say “clean.” Which answer was given more often?
questions.discussion: Tiga jawaban **large** lebih banyak daripada dua jawaban **clean**.

questions.text: The office is small. The classroom is big. What is different?
questions.discussion: Kata **small** dan **big** membandingkan ukuran.

questions.text: The restroom is narrow and clean. Which word tells about cleanliness?
questions.discussion: **Clean** menjelaskan kebersihan.

questions.text: The schoolyard is wide and dirty. Which word tells about width?
questions.discussion: **Wide** menjelaskan lebar.

questions.text: Which sentence is a suitable answer to “How is the prayer room?”
questions.discussion: Pertanyaan **How is ...?** dijawab dengan kondisi tempat.

questions.text: A report says, “The library is big, clean, and beside the office.” Which word tells its location?
questions.discussion: **Beside** menerangkan letak, sedangkan big dan clean menerangkan kondisi.

questions.text: Which sentence gives no information about cleanliness?
questions.discussion: **Large** hanya menjelaskan ukuran.

questions.text: The classroom is small and clean. Which conclusion is correct?
options: A small room can also be clean.
Small and clean cannot be used together.
questions.answer: A small room can also be clean.
questions.discussion: Dua kondisi berbeda dapat dimiliki ruangan yang sama.
